inspiration.observed_pattern: SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS with a LEFT JOIN and offset pagination must update FOUND_ROWS() consistently after a later ordinary limited read.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to three catalog rows, one category lookup with a missing category, and paired buffered and ordinary offset pages so the session count transition is isolated.

fixture_notes: Three rows match the join query. The buffered page starts at offset one and FOUND_ROWS() must report three; the later ordinary page returns two rows and FOUND_ROWS() must then report two.
determinism_notes: Fixed integer IDs and labels are ordered by the unique item ID; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_categories (category_id INT PRIMARY KEY, category_name VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mini_items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, category_id INT NOT NULL, item_name VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS i.item_id, i.item_name, c.category_name FROM mini_items i LEFT JOIN mini_categories c ON c.category_id = i.category_id ORDER BY i.item_id LIMIT 1, 2
SELECT i.item_id, i.item_name, c.category_name FROM mini_items i LEFT JOIN mini_categories c ON c.category_id = i.category_id ORDER BY i.item_id LIMIT 1, 2

checks.sql: SELECT i.item_id, i.item_name, i.category_id FROM mini_items i ORDER BY i.item_id
